QuestInfo.name: Path of a True Mapler
QuestInfo.0: For a year, Neinheart's been unwilling to train anyone who's not a Cygnus Knights. But for MapleStory's 5th Anniversary, he's going to be generous and train all Maplers. Go see him in Ereve.
QuestInfo.1: Neinheart's training you. Training you hard. Prove yourself a worthy Mapler and get #b50 Seal Tooth.
QuestInfo.2: For a year, Neinheart's been unwilling to train anyone who's not a Cygnus Knights. But for MapleStory's 5th Anniversary, he's going to be generous and train all Maplers.

0.0: I am Neinheart, commander of the Cygnus Knights. Though our knighthood was founded one short year ago, we have been at the forefront of defending Maple World from the vile Black Mage. We must never let down our guard. Therefore, I will let you train with me this week.

yes.0: Since you are not a Cygnus Knight, I'd rather not sully the grounds of Ereve with your footprints. Therefore, go to Aqua Road and get #b50 Seal Teeth.#k Return when you are done.

no.0: Then we have nothing more to discuss. Good day.
